decisions.reason: The authentication and identity delegation service sits close to the core offer, costs little to maintain, and has gained visibility, moving from a mention to a page of its own, so the option is still worth holding while demand resolves.

The open GIS development framework is close to the firm's core and supports its open, extensible component strategy, but it is still only mentioned rather than featured, so it stays as a low-cost option with modest uncertainty about its traction.
The identity service for GIS applications is actively promoted with a dedicated page and specific launch messaging, which signals positive resolution and makes further commitment worthwhile.
The consulting workshop launched in 2024 is still early and its value is uncertain, and as a low-cost service that uses existing consultants it is worth keeping as an option.
